=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3473-3486 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the `/compare` API call fails or returns no `merge_base_commit.sha`, `PHASE7_MERGE_BASE_SHA=""`, the inner `if [ -n "${PHASE7_MERGE_BASE_SHA}" ]` skips the merge-base blob fetch and `phase7_merge_base_blob` stays initialized to `""`; the subsequent comparison evaluates true for every PR file with a non-empty `phase7_base_blob`, so `_phase7_take_base_version` rewrites every overlapping file with the base version.
  WHY: A transient `/compare` failure causes one spurious `[E2E Smoke Test]` PUT and commit per overlapping PR file, floods the run log with `PHASE7_UNCONFLICT_FILE outcome=replaced_with_base` lines, and bypasses the intended fail-closed overlap-only rule.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3481-3485 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fail-closed intent of the overlap-only rewrite is undermined because an empty `phase7_merge_base_blob` is indistinguishable from a valid empty-blob state when `/compare` fails.
  WHY: Every transient `/compare` failure triggers a full overwrite of every overlapping PR file, producing spurious commits and noisy logs while the retried merge still fails on the original conflict.
- Requirement: "on a 409 it overwrites each PR file the base also changed since the merge base with the base's version (contents API, `[E2E Smoke Test]` commit prefix), retries once, and waits for mergeability to be recomputed" (PR description); agents.md: "on a 409 it overwrites each PR file the base also changed since the merge base with the base's version"; changelog fragment: "on a conflict it overwrites each PR file the base also changed with the base's version".
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml inside the 409-recovery loop where `phase7_base_blob` is compared to `phase7_merge_base_blob`.
  Evidence of absence: The comparison at lines 3481-3486 has no fallback for when `/compare` fails to return a merge-base SHA; an empty `phase7_merge_base_blob` (the initialized default) makes the comparison evaluate true for every overlapping file, so the implementation rewrites files the base did not actually change. No diff hunk in the PR or LAST RUN DIFF introduces a fail-closed guard (e.g. adding `[ -n "${phase7_merge_base_blob}" ]` to the comparison, or skipping the rewrite entirely when `PHASE7_MERGE_BASE_SHA` is empty). The `test_unconflict_only_rewrites_files_the_base_changed_since_merge_base` test asserts the API calls and the comparison string are present, but does not pin the fail-closed behavior when the merge-base blob cannot be determined, so the gap is not caught at test time either.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3481-3488 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the `/compare` API call fails or returns no `merge_base_commit.sha`, `PHASE7_MERGE_BASE_SHA` is empty, `phase7_merge_base_blob` remains initialized to `""`, and the condition evaluates true for any non-empty base blob, causing `_phase7_take_base_version` to rewrite every PR file with the base version.
  WHY: On a `/compare` API failure, the workflow produces spurious `PHASE7_UNCONFLICT_FILE outcome=replaced_with_base` lines and unnecessary commits for files the base never touched; the intended fail-closed behavior is bypassed.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3481-3488 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The code does not distinguish between “merge-base blob is empty because the file did not exist at merge-base” and “merge-base blob is empty because the `/compare` API call failed.”
  WHY: Both cases result in `phase7_merge_base_blob=""`, so when `/compare` fails the workflow rewrites files it should have kept.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3481-3486 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the `/compare` API call at line 3473 fails or returns no `merge_base_commit.sha`, `PHASE7_MERGE_BASE_SHA` is empty, `phase7_merge_base_blob` remains at its initialized `""`, and the comparison evaluates true for every PR file with a non-empty base blob, causing `_phase7_take_base_version` to rewrite all PR files with the base version instead of only files the base changed since the merge base.
  WHY: On a transient `/compare` API failure, every PR file gets a spurious PUT call and a `replaced_with_base` commit on the throwaway smoke branch; the retry merge still sees the original conflict on untouched files, while the branch carries spurious commits and the log is noisy.
  HARDENING_SUGGESTION: Add a guard so the rewrite only proceeds when the merge-base blob was actually fetched: change the condition to `if [ -n "${phase7_base_blob}" ] && [ -n "${PHASE7_MERGE_BASE_SHA}" ] && [ "${phase7_base_blob}" != "${phase7_merge_base_blob}" ]`, and move the `else` log to say `reason=merge_base_unavailable` when `PHASE7_MERGE_BASE_SHA` is empty.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
